mods.name: Literally Nothing
mods.description: The ultimate universal mod that does literally nothing and runs on everything. There are no changes to the game. On server version it might say the plugins name, but it still does nothing.

releases.notes:
### JAR CHANGELOG:

Expanded cross-platform compatibility to include the final remaining loaders and server environments.

- **Added Mod Loaders**: Rift, LiteLoader, Risugami's ModLoader

- **Added Servers**: Sponge

The project has now officially marked and covered **every single platform** in the Modrinth compatibility matrix.


### RESOURCE PACK CHANGELOG:

Warning - from version 1.21.6 to 26.1.2 you will get a warning about incompatibility. Ignore that, on "Are you sure you want to load this pack?" click "Yes" and it just works!

On version 26.2 it does not show this red thing, it will work fine.

If you try to load the Resource Pack on any earlier version than 1.21.6 the pack will just not appear in the menu. It is possible to add support for earlier versions, but these are fine for now.

What it does to your game: Replaces the splash text on main menu with "Literally Nothing!"


### SHADER CHANGELOG:

Works on: Optifine, Iris Shaders and Canvas Renderer
Version: 1.7.10 - 26.2
